name: mobileproxy
description: Control dedicated 4G mobile and residential proxies on mobileproxy.space: rotate IPs, change geo, check balance, buy.
long_description: Gives Claude direct control over your mobileproxy.space account. Each mobile proxy is a dedicated 4G/LTE modem with a real carrier IP that stays yours for as long as you need: test sites and apps as mobile users in a given country and network see them, check ads and localized content by geo, or monitor prices. Rotate the IP on demand, move a proxy to another country or operator without re-buying, renew and configure proxies in bulk, set the network-level OS fingerprint, and manage traffic-billed residential packages. Anything that changes a proxy or charges the balance asks for your confirmation first.
